scenes.title: Hook
scenes.line: It's 10:42 at night. A parent asks about JEE fees, and the institute is closed.

scenes.title: The problem
scenes.line: Most enquiries arrive in the evening or during class. When nobody replies, the student asks the next institute.

scenes.title: Meet VidyaDesk
scenes.line: Meet VidyaDesk, an AI assistant for coaching institutes.

scenes.title: Instant answer, any language
scenes.line: It answers fees, batches and timings from the institute's own facts, with exact numbers, in English, Hindi, Hinglish or Odia.

scenes.title: Lead captured, owner alerted
scenes.line: While it chats, it saves the student's name, class and course, rates their interest, and alerts the owner the moment a lead is hot.

scenes.title: Hands off to a person
scenes.line: When a parent wants a person, it hands the chat to the owner, and passes on any new messages.

scenes.title: The dashboard
scenes.line: Every enquiry lands in the VidyaDesk dashboard: who needs a call, every conversation, and a CSV for Excel.

scenes.title: Never forgets to follow up
scenes.line: If a student goes quiet, it follows up once, politely. Every morning at eight, the owner gets a summary.

scenes.title: Under the hood
scenes.line: Under the hood: a LangGraph agent, document search with pgvector, and measured results: twenty-six of twenty-six behaviour checks, and three hundred and sixteen automated tests.

scenes.title: Close
scenes.line: VidyaDesk. Every enquiry answered. Every lead captured.
